thread:
rachel: FYI schedule for APAC maintenance tomorrow 02:00-04:00 JST. Targeting apac-west1 edge pool + a small slice of dedicated-gpu for nvlink microcode and NIC firmware. will do rolling reboots in cohorts of 8 nodes.
tom: ok which pools exactly and expected loss of capacity?
priya: apac-west1-edge (aurora-pool) and dedicated-gpu-az9 (slice B). planning to cordon 10% then drain cohorts to avoid mass cold-starts. estimated generation capacity drop ~18% and a short KV cache cold period per cohort.
infra_bot: preflight tests: nvlink fw v1.2.3 applied on one test node — reboot success, nvlink peers re-established in ~35s, no GPU errors logged.
cost-ops: heads up on backfill cost if we spin cloud-burst preemptible in apac at odd hours, historical rate spike ~1.8x baseline. set budget guard?
rachel: yes. propose to avoid burstbackfill unless queueing >200rps sustained for 5m. if triggered, cap preemptible spend to $400 for the window and notify thread.
tom: any network changes? last time NIC microcode caused transient ARP storms on rack.
priya: good call. we'll toggle nic flaps sequentially with 5-min spacing between nodes in a rack. no BGP changes. plan to watch egress drops and arpmiss counters. rollback criteria: >3% packet loss observed for >2m or any kernel oops.
infra_bot: scheduling canaries: 01:50 JST single canary node in apac-west1. 02:10 JST cohort-1 (8 nodes) apac-west1. 02:40 JST canary in az9 dedicated (2 nodes), 03:00 cohort-1 az9 (8 nodes).
cost-ops: added cost monitor to thread — will post if preemptible cost > $200 in 20m.
rachel: checklist: pin runbook (https://runbooks.redwood.internal/nvlink-maint), attach dashboard (link to grafana), ensure oncall phone-alert active. Priya, you handle drains, Tom you watch networking and overlay metrics.
priya: drain snippet:
```
# cordon node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-23 -n inference
# graceful drain (120s grace)
kubectl drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 -n inference
# post-drain kv cache reseed trigger
curl -X POST https://orchestrator.internal/reseed?node=gpu-node-23
```
tom: add step to mark kv-cache-warm=false in metadata so autoscaler doesn't immediately scale down warm replicas.
infra_bot: REMINDER: running preflight load test at 01:30 JST — will post results.
infra_bot: PREFLIGHT: synthetic load 100rps for 5m against canary returned p95 latency 220ms, model load times 1.8s, kvcache hit 92%. no errors.
cost-ops: budget policy enforced. if preemptible spend crosses $400, auto-disable backfill and reduce cohort size by 50%.
rachel: decision rights: I'll approve rollback. Priya will close cohort and re-open only after p95 < 350ms and kv hit > 70% for 10m. Tom escalate to network-eng if ARP anomalies spike.
priya: will document quick-rollback commands and snapshot local caches to S3 before drain start.
tom: will prepare packet-capture playbook and quick eBPF probes.
infra_bot: maintenance notice posted to #status-mailing 30m before window.
rachel: thanks. small ask: please collect a short post-mortem note in this thread after the window — include total preemptible spend, any customer impact, and lessons. :thumbsup:
